svg.title: 3. From a quantity to the exact GPU units
svg.desc: Illustrative job 42 requests two GPUs through ResourceRequirement. An Allocation records its assignment. Two separate AllocationNode records identify GPU ResourceNode 87 on physical Node 12 and ResourceNode 91 on Node 13. The same unit links support precise release.
svg.metadata: Lettering: Virgil by Ellinor Rapp. SIL Open Font License 1.1. https://github.com/excalidraw/virgil

g.aria-label: 3. From a quantity to the exact GPU units
One request for two GPUs; two allocation links remember which GPUs it received.
Completion follows the same links to release GPUs 87 and 91.
Example IDs; relationships follow the actual models.
